text: And if the stepping is undesirable, it should not be desired. This is because common experience is unobstructed and conscious, [distinguishing that] a mountain is shorter and a long arm is not longer. Nor can it be said that the usage of that which determines the form is based on the possession of shortness etc., since this is not observed in a mirror etc. Moreover, if the knowledge arising from an object imitates its blue-form, then if it also imitated insentience, the knowledge itself would be insentient.
